description: Danielle Schmidt at the DLR Institute of Networked Energy publishes Python workflows, inputs and outputs for regional industrial load shifting in Germany. The November 2019 ZIP separates electrically powered industrial processes, electric process heat, future projections and reference tables. Processes include cement milling, mechanical pulping, paper production and air separation. Current estimates use NUTS-3 regions, while future annual averages extend nationally to 2050. Output data are CC BY 4.0 and scripts Apache-2.0; input-source terms are documented separately. The freely downloadable package can parameterise industrial flexibility in power-system simulations. Time resolution, input vintages, sector completeness and uncertainty remain unknown from the public summary. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this thesis package. Its national projections should not be interpreted as observed future capacity. Scripts and input tables were not downloaded or run.
